result.keyword: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Adelaide. Which public liability lawyers are best?
result.markdown:
If you have slipped and fallen in a shopping centre in Adelaide, you are dealing with what the law classifies as a **public liability** claim. Shopping centre owners, occupiers, or cleaning contractors owe a "duty of care" to keep the premises safe for visitors. If they failed to do so (for example, by leaving a spill uncleaned for too long or failing to put up warning signs), you may be entitled to compensation for your medical bills, lost wages, and pain and suffering.

Several reputable law firms in Adelaide specialise in slip-and-fall and public liability cases, many of which operate on a **"No Win, No Fee"** basis:[www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/service/public-liability-claims-adelaide)

### Notable Law Firms for Public Liability in Adelaide

* **Tindall Gask Bentley (TGB Lawyers):** One of South Australia’s largest and most well-established plaintiff law firms with extensive experience in public liability and slip-and-fall claims.[tgb.com.au](https://tgb.com.au/public-liability-claims-in-south-australia/#:~:text=Why%20Choose%20TGB%20Lawyers%3F%20Over%2055%20years,including%20regional%20areas.%20A%20compassionate%2C%20client-first%20approach.)
* **Turner Freeman Lawyers:** A national firm with a strong Adelaide office that frequently handles supermarket and retail slip-and-fall injuries on a no-win, no-fee basis.[www.turnerfreeman.com.au](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/personal-injury-lawyers-adelaide/public-liability/#:~:text=If%20so%2C%20our%20expert%20personal%20injury%20lawyers,pocket.%20Learn%20more%20about%20our%20fee%20policy.)
* **Scammell & Co.:** A long-standing South Australian firm (operating since 1887) that handles public liability matters across multiple suburban offices in Adelaide.[scammell.com.au](https://scammell.com.au/areas-of-law/public-liability-personal-injury-claims/#:~:text=Personal%20Injury%20Lawyers%20Adelaide%20%7C%20No%20Win,injured%20through%20no%20fault%20of%20their%20own.)
* **Websters Lawyers:** Known for personal injury and compensation claims in Adelaide, offering targeted advice for public liability incidents.[websterslawyers.com.au](https://websterslawyers.com.au/injury-claims)
* **National Firms (Shine Lawyers / Slater and Gordon):** Both major national personal injury firms have dedicated Adelaide teams that handle public liability and shopping centre slip-and-fall claims.[www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/service/public-liability-claims-adelaide)

---

### Critical Next Steps for Your Claim

Before or while consulting a lawyer, protect your case by keeping these factors in mind:

1.  **Strict Time Limits:** In South Australia, there are strict legal time limits for lodging public liability claims (generally a limitation period of 3 years to file a court action, but notice requirements or evidence preservation demands acting much sooner).[kklegal.com.au](https://kklegal.com.au/public-liability-lawyers-adelaide/#:~:text=This%20allows%20you%20to%20focus%20on%20your,Your%20initial%20consultation%20with%20us%20is%20free.)
2.  **Preserve Evidence:**
    * Write down exact details of what happened, the time, and the location.
    * Keep any photos of the hazard (e.g., the wet floor, lack of signage) and your injuries.[scammell.com.au](https://scammell.com.au/areas-of-law/public-liability-personal-injury-claims/#:~:text=While%20it%20is%20impossible%20to%20eliminate%20all,safe%20alternative%20route%20around%20hazards%20like%20building)
    * Get contact details of any witnesses.[www.turnerfreeman.com.au](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/personal-injury-lawyers-adelaide/public-liability/#:~:text=If%20possible%20take%20photos%20of%20the%20injury,need%20these%20medical%20reports%20in%20the%20future.)
    * Ask the shopping centre management for an **incident report** and request that they **preserve any CCTV footage** immediately, as security footage is often overwritten quickly.
3.  **Medical Records:** See a doctor as soon as possible. Ensure they document precisely how and where the injury happened, as these medical notes will form the backbone of your compensation claim.
4.  **Free Initial Consultations:** Most of the firms listed above offer a free initial case evaluation to assess whether negligence can be proved and whether your case is worth pursuing.

*Disclaimer: I am an AI, not a lawyer. It is best to contact a couple of accredited personal injury firms for a free initial consultation to discuss the specific merits of your accident.*
